name: Tracker Payment Transaction 15
definition: Key elements used to identify the original transaction(s) that is being referred to.

TrackedMessageIdentification.name: Tracked Message Identification
TrackedMessageIdentification.definition: Provides information on the original tracked message that contained the transaction.

TrackerInformingParty.name: Tracker Informing Party
TrackerInformingParty.definition: Party that provides information on the status and related details of a transaction.

TrackerInformedParty.name: Tracker Informed Party
TrackerInformedParty.definition: Party that is updated on the status and related details of a transaction.

TechnicalSender.name: Technical Sender
TechnicalSender.definition: The party indicated as sender in the technical header of an ISO payment message.

TechnicalReceiver.name: Technical Receiver
TechnicalReceiver.definition: The party indicated as receiver in the technical header of an ISO payment message.

PaymentIdentification.name: Payment Identification
PaymentIdentification.definition: Set of elements used to reference a payment instruction.

RelatedPaymentIdentification.name: Related Payment Identification
RelatedPaymentIdentification.definition: Set of elements identifying transactions associated with the payment instruction.

OriginalInstructionIdentification.name: Original Instruction Identification
OriginalInstructionIdentification.definition: Unique identification, as assigned by the original instructing party for the original instructed party, to unambiguously identify the original instruction.

OriginalEndToEndIdentification.name: Original End To End Identification
OriginalEndToEndIdentification.definition: Unique identification, as assigned by the original initiating party, to unambiguously identify the original transaction.

PaymentTypeInformation.name: Payment Type Information
PaymentTypeInformation.definition: Set of elements used to further specify the type of transaction.

PaymentScenario.name: Payment Scenario
PaymentScenario.definition: Specifies the business scenarios in which the payment is executed, such as customer credit transfer or cover payment.

SettlementInformation.name: Settlement Information
SettlementInformation.definition: Specifies the details on how the settlement of the transaction(s) between the instructing agent and the instructed agent is completed.

InstructingAgent.name: Instructing Agent
InstructingAgent.definition: Agent that instructs the next party in the chain to carry out the (set of) instruction(s).

InstructedAgent.name: Instructed Agent
InstructedAgent.definition: Agent that is instructed by the previous party in the chain to carry out the (set of) instruction(s).

InterbankSettlementAmount.name: Interbank Settlement Amount
InterbankSettlementAmount.definition: Amount of money moved between the instructing agent and the instructed agent.

ReturnedInterbankSettlementAmount.name: Returned Interbank Settlement Amount
ReturnedInterbankSettlementAmount.definition: Amount of money to be moved between the instructing agent and the instructed agent in the returned instruction.

InterbankSettlementDate.name: Interbank Settlement Date
InterbankSettlementDate.definition: Date on which the amount of money ceases to be available to the agent that owes it and when the amount of money becomes available to the agent to which it is due.

RequestedExecutionDate.name: Requested Execution Date
RequestedExecutionDate.definition: Date at which the initiating party requests the clearing agent to process the payment. |Usage: This is the date on which the debtor's account is to be debited. If payment by cheque, the date when the cheque must be generated by the bank.

SettlementPriority.name: Settlement Priority
SettlementPriority.definition: Indicator of the urgency or order of importance that the instructing party would like the instructed party to apply to the processing of the settlement instruction.

SettlementTimeIndication.name: Settlement Time Indication
SettlementTimeIndication.definition: Provides information on the occurred settlement time(s) of the payment transaction.

SettlementTimeRequest.name: Settlement Time Request
SettlementTimeRequest.definition: Provides information on the requested settlement time(s) of the payment instruction.

AcceptanceDateTime.name: Acceptance Date Time
AcceptanceDateTime.definition: Point in time when the payment order from the initiating party meets the processing conditions of the account servicing agent. This means that the account servicing agent has received the payment order and has applied checks such as authorisation, availability of funds.

PoolingAdjustmentDate.name: Pooling Adjustment Date
PoolingAdjustmentDate.definition: Date used for the correction of the value date of a cash pool movement that has been posted with a different value date.

InstructedAmount.name: Instructed Amount
InstructedAmount.definition: Amount of money to be moved between the debtor and creditor, before deduction of charges, expressed in the currency as ordered by the initiating party.|Usage: This amount has to be transported unchanged through the transaction chain.

EquivalentAmount.name: Equivalent Amount
EquivalentAmount.definition: Amount of money to be moved between the debtor and creditor, expressed in the currency of the debtor's account, and the currency in which the amount is to be moved.

ReturnedInstructedAmount.name: Returned Instructed Amount
ReturnedInstructedAmount.definition: Amount of money to be moved between the debtor and the creditor, before deduction of charges, in the returned transaction.|Usage: This amount has to be transported unchanged through the transaction chain.

ExchangeRateData.name: Exchange Rate Data
ExchangeRateData.definition: Provides details on the rate and the currencies used in the foreign exchange.

ForeignExchangeAgent.name: Foreign Exchange Agent
ForeignExchangeAgent.definition: Agent that performed the foreign exchange operation.

ChargeBearer.name: Charge Bearer
ChargeBearer.definition: Specifies which party/parties will bear the charges associated with the processing of the payment transaction.

ChargesInformation.name: Charges Information
ChargesInformation.definition: Provides information on the charges to be paid by the charge bearer(s) related to the payment transaction.

TrackerRecord.name: Tracker Record
TrackerRecord.definition: Provides tracker transaction information for a specific agent involved in the transaction chain.

TrackerData.name: Tracker Data
TrackerData.definition: Provides information on the tracking of the interbank transaction related to the payment.

DebitConfirmationURLAddress.name: Debit Confirmation URL Address
DebitConfirmationURLAddress.definition: Address for the Universal Resource Locator (URL), for example an address used over the www (HTTP) service that provides confirmation a payment has debited an account.

PreviousInstructingAgent1.name: Previous Instructing Agent 1
PreviousInstructingAgent1.definition: Agent immediately prior to the instructing agent.

PreviousInstructingAgent1Account.name: Previous Instructing Agent 1 Account
PreviousInstructingAgent1Account.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account of the previous instructing agent at its servicing agent in the payment chain.

PreviousInstructingAgent2.name: Previous Instructing Agent 2
PreviousInstructingAgent2.definition: Agent immediately prior to the instructing agent.

PreviousInstructingAgent2Account.name: Previous Instructing Agent 2 Account
PreviousInstructingAgent2Account.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account of the previous instructing agent at its servicing agent in the payment chain.

PreviousInstructingAgent3.name: Previous Instructing Agent 3
PreviousInstructingAgent3.definition: Agent immediately prior to the instructing agent.

PreviousInstructingAgent3Account.name: Previous Instructing Agent 3 Account
PreviousInstructingAgent3Account.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account of the previous instructing agent at its servicing agent in the payment chain.

IntermediaryAgent1.name: Intermediary Agent 1
IntermediaryAgent1.definition: Agent between the debtor's agent and the creditor's agent.||Usage: If more than one intermediary agent is present, then IntermediaryAgent1 identifies the agent between the DebtorAgent and the IntermediaryAgent2.

IntermediaryAgent1Account.name: Intermediary Agent 1 Account
IntermediaryAgent1Account.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account of the intermediary agent 1 at its servicing agent in the payment chain.

IntermediaryAgent2.name: Intermediary Agent 2
IntermediaryAgent2.definition: Agent between the debtor's agent and the creditor's agent.||Usage: If more than two intermediary agents are present, then IntermediaryAgent2 identifies the agent between the IntermediaryAgent1 and the IntermediaryAgent3.

IntermediaryAgent2Account.name: Intermediary Agent 2 Account
IntermediaryAgent2Account.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account of the intermediary agent 2 at its servicing agent in the payment chain.

IntermediaryAgent3.name: Intermediary Agent 3
IntermediaryAgent3.definition: Agent between the debtor's agent and the creditor's agent.||Usage: If IntermediaryAgent3 is present, then it identifies the agent between the IntermediaryAgent 2 and the CreditorAgent.

IntermediaryAgent3Account.name: Intermediary Agent 3 Account
IntermediaryAgent3Account.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account of the intermediary agent 3 at its servicing agent in the payment chain.

UltimateDebtor.name: Ultimate Debtor
UltimateDebtor.definition: Ultimate party that owes an amount of money to the (ultimate) creditor.

InitiatingParty.name: Initiating Party
InitiatingParty.definition: Party that initiates the payment.|Usage: This can be either the debtor or a party that initiates the credit transfer on behalf of the debtor.

Debtor.name: Debtor
Debtor.definition: Party that owes an amount of money to the (ultimate) creditor.

DebtorAccount.name: Debtor Account
DebtorAccount.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account of the debtor to which a debit entry will be made as a result of the transaction.

DebtorAgent.name: Debtor Agent
DebtorAgent.definition: Financial institution servicing an account for the debtor.

DebtorAgentAccount.name: Debtor Agent Account
DebtorAgentAccount.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account of the debtor agent at its servicing agent in the payment chain.

CreditorAgent.name: Creditor Agent
CreditorAgent.definition: Financial institution servicing an account for the creditor.

CreditorAgentAccount.name: Creditor Agent Account
CreditorAgentAccount.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account of the creditor agent at its servicing agent to which a credit entry will be made as a result of the payment transaction.

Creditor.name: Creditor
Creditor.definition: Party to which an amount of money is due.

CreditorAccount.name: Creditor Account
CreditorAccount.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account of the creditor to which a credit entry will be posted as a result of the payment transaction.

UltimateCreditor.name: Ultimate Creditor
UltimateCreditor.definition: Ultimate party to which an amount of money is due.

InstructionForCreditorAgent.name: Instruction For Creditor Agent
InstructionForCreditorAgent.definition: Further information related to the processing of the payment instruction, provided by the initiating party, and intended for the creditor agent.

InstructionForNextAgent.name: Instruction For Next Agent
InstructionForNextAgent.definition: Further information related to the processing of the payment instruction that may need to be acted upon by the next agent. ||Usage: The next agent may not be the creditor agent.|The instruction can relate to a level of service, can be an instruction that has to be executed by the agent, or can be information required by the next agent.

Purpose.name: Purpose
Purpose.definition: Underlying reason for the payment transaction.|Usage: Purpose is used by the end-customers, that is initiating party, (ultimate) debtor, (ultimate) creditor to provide information concerning the nature of the payment. Purpose is a content element, which is not used for processing by any of the agents involved in the payment chain.

RegulatoryReporting.name: Regulatory Reporting
RegulatoryReporting.definition: Information needed due to regulatory and statutory requirements.

RelatedRemittanceInformation.name: Related Remittance Information
RelatedRemittanceInformation.definition: Provides information related to the handling of the remittance information by any of the agents in the transaction processing chain.

RemittanceInformation.name: Remittance Information
RemittanceInformation.definition: Information supplied to enable the matching of an entry with the items that the transfer is intended to settle, such as commercial invoices in an accounts' receivable system.

RejectReturnReason.name: Reject Return Reason
RejectReturnReason.definition: Provides detailed information on the return reason.

ReturnChain.name: Return Chain
ReturnChain.definition: Provides all parties (agents and non-agents) involved in a return transaction.

UnderlyingCustomerCreditTransfer.name: Underlying Customer Credit Transfer
UnderlyingCustomerCreditTransfer.definition: Provides information on the underlying customer credit transfer for which cover is provided.
